instruments.provenance_note: Both listed alignment commits contain identical gate and broad-runner blobs; the QMS document fast-forward did not change effective instrument bytes.

runtime.scope_note: The evaluator uses MongoDB. PostgreSQL and Vault are outer services supplied by the general broad runner; their presence is not PostgreSQL evaluator acceptance.

controls.mechanism: Suppress the existing physical write-trigger subscriber during actual HTTP entry mutations.
controls.assertion: post refreshes one coalesced retained cycle

controls.mechanism: Alter the shipping clinical setter output on the selected current-reading cohort.
controls.assertion: next actual trigger observes entries B

controls.mechanism: Clear the retained successful result when a selected materialization callback fails after real rows arrive.
controls.assertion: failed materialization preserves the previous timestamp and clinical properties

fresh_default_browser.scope: Default configured browser tier; no complete cross-engine matrix claim.

measurements.count_scope: Campaigns overlap; do not add them as independent coverage.

cleanup.method: Record successful detached container IDs and mount volume names before cleanup; augment removal only for known current IDs; independently require explicit missing-resource responses after cleanup.
cleanup.scope: Only exact captured IDs. Unknown resources, named or attached resources, and failed creates without returned IDs are outside this audit; no universal zero-leak claim.

privacy.public_capture: Aggregate counts, source and dependency hashes, versions and assertion descriptions only.
privacy.excluded: Machine paths, container and volume identities, service addresses, raw runtime configuration, credential values, document bodies and traces.
privacy.per_slot: One exclusive serialized profile slot; every captured campaign resource was checked after its own cleanup before advancing.

preserved_boundaries: Private per-acquisition helper and materialized targets remain distinct; caller cache and bus are not inherited.
Independent evaluateCycle definition and export retained; REST helper bytes and views allocation hunks match exactly.
Existing bounds, future-record handling, statistics failures, typed-identity union, evaluation cadence and retained-result policies unchanged.
Actual selected concurrent-read schedule remains mixed entries A and treatments B, followed by B and B on a real trigger.
Selected callback failure is injected after real rows arrive; it is not a real database-outage test.
limits: No common database revision, stronger snapshot isolation, settings or plugin version key guarantee.
No logical subscriber switch, executable v1 or socket admission, default-role change, or REST branch join.
Teardown checks establish no late fake-provider delivery; they do not establish database cancellation, absence of internal handoff, or immutable closed state.
Complete clinical and writer cohorts, live statistics freshness, runtime cost, durable notification state and multitenant recovery remain open.
No milestone promotion, release placement or production enablement. All commits remain local at capture; no push by this lane.

evidence_grade.policy_preservation: read-derived exact source equivalence, supported by the scoped runtime checks
